fact: At the National Assembly plenary of 29 September 2026, deputies noted that holders of the biometric ECOWAS ID card, which doubles as the voter card, can carry the mention 'NE PEUT PAS VOTER' unless they are registered on the electoral lists.
title: Prorogation des cartes biométriques CEDEAO : le droit de vote des primo-votants et les territoriales au cœur des débats à l'Hémicycle
